checks.hypothesis_check: The free scalar C241 action on S3 gives the closed spherical lens-space group C241. Primality follows by division by the primes at most sqrt(241); its only proper subgroup has index 241, so the allowed bound cannot avoid it.
checks.decisive_check: A rational matrix with exact prime order 241 is diagonalizable because x^241âˆ’1 is square-free in characteristic zero, and at least one eigenvalue is a nontrivial 241st root. Its minimal polynomial Phi241 is irreducible of degree 240 by Eisenstein after translation, contradicting dimension 3. This validates the literal integral-embedding defect.
checks.repair_check: For semidirect multiplication (v,k)(w,l)=(v+A^k w,k+l), block multiplication of 2^k[[A^k,v],[0,1]] reproduces that law. The lower-right entry determines k and then the translation determines v. All matrices are invertible over the fixed field C. Cyclic groups and Z3 have the explicit faithful diagonal representations stated in the report. Lemma 3.1 and the unchanged bounded-index proposition therefore supply exactly the needed auxiliary result.
